notes.title: Singularity Survivors is Evolving!
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

First, we want to sincerely apologize for the recent silence and lack of updates. Developing Singularity Survivors has been a challenging journey, often led by just one person at a time. The process has been demanding, but the passion and determination to deliver a great experience have never wavered.

This quiet period wasn’t due to inactivity, far from it. Every moment has been spent rethinking, redesigning, and rebuilding the game to create something truly special. This isn’t just an update; it’s a massive overhaul, the result of countless hours of hard work and dedication.

If everything goes as planned, this update will be ready by the end of this month. It’s the most ambitious yet, packed with exciting features, enhanced mechanics, and improvements that will take Singularity Survivors to the next level. Thank you for your patience and support, it means everything.

Here’s what’s new so far, but trust us, this isn’t even everything:

[b]Core Engine Upgrade[/b]
    •    Upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.4: Experience stunning visuals, smoother performance, and cutting-edge technology that brings the world of Singularity Survivors to life.

[b]Revamped Combat System[/b]
Combat has been completely reimagined to make every encounter more thrilling:
    •    Melee Combat Reimagined: The old, basic melee system is gone. In its place, we’ve introduced dynamic, impactful melee mechanics with fluid animations and varied attacks.
    •    Improved Gunplay: Shooting has been rebuilt from the ground up, offering faster, more responsive, and satisfying gameplay.
    •    New Abilities & Skill Tree Enhancements: Customize your survivor with powerful new abilities and an overhauled skill tree system.

[b]New Mutant Classes[/b]
The mutant roster grows more terrifying with two new additions:
    •    Cyber Zombie: A horrifying fusion of metal and flesh, relentless in pursuit.
    •    Demon Beast: A monstrous, towering adversary that will test your skills to the limit.

[b]All-New Mission Types[/b]
Keep every playthrough fresh with new mission types:
    •    Zone Defense: Protect key locations from waves of enemies.
    •    Swarm Attack: Survive relentless, chaotic hordes of mutants.
    •    Roaming Horde: Face unpredictable, wandering threats for unique rewards.

[b]Dynamic World Events[/b]
The world of Singularity Survivors is now more alive and dangerous:
    •    Hive Breaches: Engage in high-risk missions by venturing into mutant nests.
    •    Roaming Horde Events: Survive massive roaming threats in dynamic locations.

[b]Environmental Upgrades[/b]
The game world has never looked better:
    •    Improved Shadow Quality: Realistic, detailed shadows add depth to every scene.
    •    Updated Weather Effects: Enjoy immersive storms, lighting, and environmental transitions.

[b]Performance Improvements[/b]
    •    Optimized object rendering to boost framerate.
    •    Fixed invalid mesh references that caused crashes when leaving the game.
    •    General framerate improvements for a smoother experience.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
    •    Resolved a rare crash when interacting with NPCs as the hosting player.
    •    Fixed a performance drop caused by loot chests in certain areas.

[b]Improved UI[/b]
    •    Redesigned UI elements with a cleaner, more modern look.
    •    Improved functionality for smoother navigation and usability.


This update represents a huge leap forward for Singularity Survivors, and we’re not done yet, there are still more surprises in the works, and we’ll reveal them soon.

Keep an eye out for a gameplay teaser coming in the next few weeks to see these incredible changes in action.

Once again, thank you for your patience and support during this time. Your enthusiasm drives us to make Singularity Survivors the best it can be. We can’t wait for you to experience everything we’ve been building.

[b]The 71 Studios Team[/b]

notes.title: Singularity Survivors v0.2 Update — Now Live!
notes.notes:
We're excited to bring you the v0.2 update for Singularity Survivors, packed with new features, improvements, and bug fixes! So if you haven't jumped in yet, now is the perfect time!

[b]Here’s what’s new in v0.2:[/b]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b] Intro Mission:[/b] A brand-new mission has been added to introduce players to the lore of Singularity Survivors.
[*] [b]Random Characters:[/b] Now, every time you join or start a game, your character will be randomly assigned. This feature is still in testing and will be refined in future updates.
[*] [b]Player Marker on World Map:[/b] Players can now see their marker on the world map! Press M to open the World Map.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Mutant Despawn Time:[/b] Mutants now despawn after 12 seconds (up from 7), giving players more time to loot them.
[*][b] Anomalies:[/b] Anomalies now have enhanced visual and sound effects, including a portal at the destination and a temporary fog cover to help players survive potential encounters with enemies upon arrival.
[*] [b]Inventory and Max Weight:[/b] Improvements to the inventory system, with increased size and max weight settings.
[*] [b]Sound Enhancements:[/b]
[*] Updated the damage sound to something more fitting.
[*] Adjusted monster sounds for a more immersive experience.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Animation Fixes:[/b] Resolved issues with buggy animations while running with a flashlight or knife, and fixed the rifle animation when running.
[*] [b]Dr. Marcus Dialogue Bug:[/b] Fixed an issue causing players to fall under the base during dialogue with Dr. Marcus.
[*] [b]Mission Save System:[/b] Fixed bugs in the mission save system.
[*] [b]Loot Boxes:[/b] Increased the chances of finding magazines in loot boxes.
[*] [b]Audio Settings:[/b] Fixed issues where certain audio effects were not responding to settings changes.
[*] [b]Weather System:[/b] Addressed bugs in the temperature system to improve accuracy and consistency.
[/list]

[b]Temporary Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Vehicle Removal:[/b] Vehicles have been temporarily removed and will return in the next patch, which is coming in a few days.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Starting a new single-player game does not reset saved missions. We are working on this and will fix it in a future update.
[/list]

Please report any bugs or feedback via our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/Xjg9pXWGwy ]Join Here[/url]. Your input helps us improve the game for everyone!

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy all the exciting new content in v0.2!

notes.title: Singularity Survivors Major Update v0.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980817/280f398b24413327b77469e05aaf6c35920c580e.jpg[/img][h1]Major Update v0.1 for Singularity Survivors[/h1]

Hello Survivors,

First, we want to extend our sincerest apologies for the delay in delivering this update. We appreciate your patience and support as we worked hard to bring this major update to life. We’re excited to finally share the huge changes and improvements we’ve made to [i]Singularity Survivors[/i]! Here’s what’s new in v0.1:

[h2]Major Changes and Additions:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980817/8504748182a37bbe29e8ee8c1f20efcf37488272.png[/img]
[*][b]Fort Exodus Expansion:[/b] Fort Exodus has now grown into a much bigger and more fortified base in the mountains, offering more protection and opportunities for exploration.
[*][b]New Main Menu Design:[/b] We've redesigned the main menu for a sleeker and more user-friendly experience.
[*][b]Main Character Redesign:[/b] The look of the main character has been updated to better fit the game's atmosphere.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980817/a39072b1c3331c029414f28fcc98d4c95c319d84.png[/img]
[*][b]Added Cars:[/b] Explore the world faster with the new cars! Drive around, scavenge, and outrun mutants.
[*][b]Fuel Stations:[/b] We've introduced fuel stations. Just hold [b]SPACE[/b] to refuel your car and keep going.
[*][b]Car Dashboard:[/b] Press [b]V[/b] to view the car dashboard, which displays the amount of fuel left, so you know when it's time to stop by a fuel station.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980817/6026f55ddd274b0d4d5b248f10756c2cd76158c7.png[/img]
[*][b]Anomalies:[/b] Random portals now appear around the world, sending players to strange and dangerous places. Prepare for the unknown!
[*][b]Base Droids:[/b] New droids in Fort Exodus will share information about the base and their origins, adding depth to your exploration.
[*][b]New Missions:[/b] Dive into brand new missions that will challenge your survival and combat skills.
[*][b]Improved Performance:[/b] The game’s overall performance has been enhanced for a smoother experience.
[*][b]More Mutants:[/b] The world just got a lot more dangerous with an increased number of mutants to fight.
[*][b]Hit Reactions for Mutants:[/b] Mutants now react to hits, giving combat a more realistic and immersive feel.
[*][b]Dynamic Temperature System:[/b] Cold weather is back! Players will now need to build fires or find shelter to stay warm, as cold weather will affect your health and stamina.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980817/8d5288822ae2d7e30434f285bd0aee6847a78d09.png[/img]
[*][b]Improved Shooting Mechanics:[/b] We've reworked the shooting mechanics, including better recoil control, spread adjustments, and camera offsets for a more satisfying experience.
[*][b]Minor Bug Fixes and Server Stability:[/b] We’ve squashed several bugs to improve server stability and performance.
[*][b]Fixed Player Name Display:[/b] Resolved an issue where player names wouldn’t display properly in the inventory/stats page [TAB].
[*][b]Mission Saving Fix:[/b] Missions will now properly save when you leave the server.
[*][b]World Map Fix:[/b] The world map should now display correctly for all players.
[*][b]Crash Fixes for Older Hardware:[/b] Fixed an issue causing random crashes for players on older hardware.


[h2]Known Issues:[/h2]

[*]Player name tags may occasionally not appear correctly. If this happens, please disconnect and rejoin the server.
[*]Some minor animations are still buggy. We’re aware of this and will fix them in the next patch.


[h2]Character Selection:[/h2]
We know many of you have been eagerly waiting for the character selection feature. Unfortunately, due to some unforeseen development challenges, we have to delay this feature. We’re working hard to bring it to you as soon as possible, and we’ll keep you updated on its progress.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

[*]Bug fixes for the issues mentioned above.
[*]New world challenges to test your survival skills.
[*]More cars to discover and use.
[*]More exciting missions.
[*]New and more dangerous monsters/mutants.


[h2]Help Us Improve:[/h2]
Your feedback is crucial to the ongoing development of [i]Singularity Survivors[/i]. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, we kindly ask that you report them in our [b]Discord[/b] channel. 

Your reports will help us keep improving the game and making it the best experience possible for everyone.

[url=https://discord.gg/Xjg9pXWGwy]https://discord.gg/Xjg9pXWGwy[/url]

Thank you again for your patience and continued support! [i]Singularity Survivors[/i] is growing and evolving thanks to your feedback. Stay tuned for more updates and keep surviving!

See you in the game!

[b]Note: The video on the store page doesn't show the content of the new major update, it will be updated soon.[/b]

[b]The 71 Studios Team[/b]

notes.title: New updates and fixes.
notes.notes:
Dear Singularity Survivors Community,

We want to extend our deepest gratitude to each and every one of you. Your support has been the driving force behind our journey, taking us from the early beta stages to our successful launch on Steam Early Access. We've come a long way, from a game that struggled with 10-20 FPS to now delivering over 100 FPS in our latest updates. Your dedication has made this possible.

Tomorrow, we're rolling out an important update that includes updated missions and the following new features:

[b]- Game Shaders Compilation[/b]:
Shaders now compile before starting the game. This ensures that all shaders are ready before you start playing, reducing and eliminating any lag related to shaders. Please note that the shaders compilation process will heavily depend on your PC specs.

[b]- Textures Fix:[/b]
We’ve fixed an issue where textures appeared blurry.

[b]- Medical Supply Bag Update:[/b]
The heal amount from the medical supply bag has been increased from 40% to 70%.

[b]- Medical Supply Usability:[/b]
Each medical supply bag is now usable only once.

[b]- Loot Boxes:[/b]
We’ve added loot boxes to the game, and major areas will no longer have random scattered loot.

[b]- Mutant Deer:[/b]
The mutant deer is now lootable, adding a new layer to your resource management.


[b]Known Issues[/b]:
- Missions might sometimes not be saved on the dedicated server. We are actively working on resolving this.

We also want to remind you that this game is still in early access, so issues are to be expected. However, with your help, we will ensure this becomes an amazing game for everyone! It would mean a lot to us if you could report any bugs and provide your feedback on our Discord channels

https://discord.gg/5xU2MBzwQn

And there's more exciting news! In our next major update coming next weekend, players will have the option to select from multiple characters, adding more customization and variety to your gameplay experience, and more exciting missions! 

Thank you for being an essential part of this journey. Your continued support and feedback are what drive us to make Singularity Survivors the best it can be.

Stay sharp and stay safe,

notes.title: A Message to Our Community and Prospective Players
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

We want to take a moment to address our community and those considering joining us in Singularity Survivors.

As an indie team, we believe in transparency and setting the right expectations. Singularity Survivors is currently in Early Access, and while it offers a rich survival experience with all the essential features, it’s still a work in progress. We know that some players are eager for a fully polished, story-driven adventure. If that’s your primary interest, you might want to wait until we further develop the narrative aspects. However, we are committed to blending a compelling story with immersive survival gameplay and are actively working toward that goal with the community’s feedback.

We understand that the game may not be perfect for everyone at this stage, especially those looking for a seamless experience. We’re dedicated to listening to your feedback and continuously improving the game. Rest assured, we’re committed to delivering a quality experience and are not here to mislead anyone. We value respectful and constructive feedback and believe that it helps us grow and enhance Singularity Survivors for everyone.

Thank you all. 

— The 71 Studios Team

notes.title: Singularity Survivors: Major Demo Update and new Features!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980817/6ae2f2bb17d91490e39cb2a9feaa12fc216b7aa8.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, Survivors![/b]

We are excited to bring you a massive update to "Singularity Survivors". we at 71 Studios, an indie game development studio, have been hard at work to enhance your gaming experience. Here’s what you can expect in this update:

[b]World:[/b]
- [b]World Rework:[/b] Almost a complete overhaul of the world with a sample river, an ocean, and a completely remade city. Enjoy significant performance improvements as you explore the new landscapes.

[b]New Items:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980817/51c0a880f649154c1b2144700baf96355daacc87.png[/img]
- [b]Assault Rifles:[/b] Introducing three new assault rifles, each with unique uses. (Note: The full game will feature 20 weapon types, each with distinct stats and capabilities).
- [b]Grenades:[/b] Added a new grenade. (Note: The full game will include 5 to 10 types of grenades, each with different powers).
- [b]Horse:[/b] A horse to ride through the vast open world.

[b]New Features:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980817/35cd6b13432a5338395018ab87ef661d07dfb49c.png[/img]
- [b]Climbing and Sliding:[/b] Completely remade the climbing system and added sliding (Press Z to slide).
- [b]Leveling and Character Stats:[/b] Gain XP from every action. The higher your level, the stronger your health, stamina, hunger, and thirst management.
- [b]Dynamic Footsteps Sounds:[/b] Hear what you’re walking on with new dynamic footsteps sounds (not fully implemented yet).
- [b]Swimming:[/b] Dive into the water! (Press Shift to rise/swim faster and Control to dive).
- [b]Realistic Damage Sound Effects:[/b] The getting damaged sound effect is now more realistic with 17 different sound effects, enhancing the immersive experience.
- [b]Sound Effects Additions and Modifications:[/b] Many additions and modifications to sound effects.
- [b]New Main Menu Design:[/b] Enjoy the redesigned main menu.
- [b]New Gunshot VFX:[/b] Experience improved visual effects for gunshots.
- [b]Improved Character Animations:[/b] Smoother and more realistic character animations.
- [b]Location Marking:[/b] Press "E" to mark a location for your friends.
- [b]Environmental Challenges:[/b] Remember to avoid snowstorms as the cold will hurt you. Craft a fire from the personal crafting menu to keep warm during cold nights.

[b]User Interface:[/b]
- [b]UI Theme:[/b] Preview the new UI theme, still a work in progress.

[b]Fixed Bugs:[/b]
- [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Various bugs fixed. Please report any new bugs in our Discord server’s bug report section.
- [b]Game Size:[/b] Reduced from 43GB to 26GB.
- [b]FPS Improvement:[/b] Improved FPS from 20fps to 70fps in most areas.
- [b]FPS Counter:[/b] Added an FPS counter for the demo.
- [b]Discord Display:[/b] Game now shows correctly on Discord.

[b]Known Bugs:[/b]
- [b]Audio Issues:[/b] No sounds for sliding and climbing yet. Not all surfaces produce the correct sounds.
- [b]Horse Animation:[/b] Horse animation in water isn’t accurate.
- [b]Fps Drops[/b]

[b]Planned Features and Updates (Beyond the Demo):[/b]
- Improved sound effects.
- More places to explore.
- More monsters to fight.
- Full UI redesign.
- Quest system.
